name: Replay command
responsibility: Renders a kept talk to a video again, in either theme, with no voice and no board
description: Needs the Archboard server only to serve the page. A talk that cannot be read, or one of another format version, is refused as a usage error before a browser starts. Its --out checks and its refusals of the browser and ffmpeg are the ones record uses (recording-output.ts).
